thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security block. Can we capture owners + small deadlines for SOC2/ISO evidence, BYO KMS, VPC/private connectivity, and audit logs?

Isha: Yep. High level: SOC2 evidence initial bundle by mid-June, BYO KMS beta targeted in ~8 weeks, expose audit-log retention up to 365d behind a flag.

Jordan: Tech note: AWS PrivateLink + VPC endpoints is our recommended no-egress option. VPC peering still supported but requires extra routing and NAT.

Maggie: ISO will need additional artifacts (access review exports, key policy snapshots). Infra please share sample exports so compliance can template.

Sam: Proposed DRIs & dates? Sales needs one place to check.

Isha: Draft DRIs: SOC2 evidence -> Isha + Kira -> due 2026-06-15. BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> due 2026-05-20. PrivateLink checklist -> Jordan -> due 2026-05-01. Audit-log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan -> due 2026-05-10.

Jordan: Will publish terraform module PR and example endpoint policy in the PrivateLink doc. Example snippet will be short and copy-paste ready.

Kira: Audit logs default 90d; we'll add tenant-level control to extend to 365d and provide export endpoints. Need product UX for retention control.

Security-Bot: Scan alert: 2 infra accounts missing explicit KMS key policy entries in last 24h. Ticket INFRA-4823 created.

Maggie: Compliance nuance: SOC2 needs key rotation docs and attestations for any external HSMs used with BYO KMS. Isha, can security prepare a customer checklist?

Isha: Yes. I'll draft a customer-facing checklist + HSM attestation template by 2026-04-28.

Sam: Also setting weekly 30m office hours for compliance Qs until SOC2 milestone. Proposed Tuesdays 9am PT. Jordan to schedule.

Sam: I'll consolidate these into Confluence and ping when live. If owners need to swap or adjust dates, reply here. :thumbsup:
